summary: PM promotes proposed high-impact assignments to delegated after #648 checkpoint approve (fleet/loop dispatch); reject/cancel blocks; run_cycle reports promotions (#648/#885).
migration_impact: After approving a PM high-impact checkpoint, the next plate_pm_run_cycle will promote the assignment and may open fleet handoffs/loops. Rejected checkpoints leave assignments blocked.
agent_notes: Do not leave high-impact PM work as proposed forever after approve. Use decide_checkpoint then plate_pm_run_cycle; promotions appear on the cycle report.
